title: Before the Rain (bc30)
synopsis: Set against a background of political turbulence in Macedonia and contemporary London, three love stories intertwine to create a powerful portrait of modern Europe. When a mysterious incident in the fabled Macedonian mountains blows out of proportion, it threatens to start a civil war, and brings together a silent young monk, a London picture editor and a disillusioned war photographer in a tragic tale of fated lovers. Before the Rain explores the uncompromising nature of war as it ravages the lives of the unsuspecting, and forces the innocent to take sides...

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 在馬其頓，東正教士立下誓言要在教堂過虔誠自律的生活，因殺害東正教徒而被通緝的少女卻無意闖進他的房間。在倫敦，編輯拒絕了和情人遠走高飛的計畫，打算和丈夫攤牌詳談，卻意外懷孕，打亂了計畫。離開了女友的攝影記者打算回到馬其頓尋根，卻發現故土已物是人非，暴力隨處可見。三段看似無關的故事暗地裡緊緊扣連，形成一個閉環。在動蕩的時代背景下，無止境的殺戮以及蒙上悲劇色彩的愛情能否逃脫命運的掣肘，覓得出路？

cast: Rade Šerbedžija, Katrin Cartlidge, Grégoire Colin, Labina Mitevska, Jay Villiers
